# API spec

SimpleInvoice API 1.0.0, from the OpenAPI document the API serves (Swagger UI at `/api/docs`, JSON at `/api/docs-json`).

## Authentication

Endpoints marked "signed in" accept any one of these. The others are public.

| Scheme   | Sent as                              |
| -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `bearer` | `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` header |
| `cookie` | `access_token` cookie                |

## Auth endpoints

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  AuthController_login["POST /auth/login<br/>Sign in<br/>public"]
  schema_LoginDto[/"LoginDto"/]
  schema_LoginResponseDto[/"LoginResponseDto"/]
  AuthController_me["GET /auth/me<br/>Current user profile<br/>signed in"]
  schema_UserProfileDto[/"UserProfileDto"/]
  AuthController_logout["POST /auth/logout<br/>Sign out<br/>public"]
  AuthController_logout_response_empty[/"no body"/]
  schema_LoginDto --> AuthController_login
  AuthController_login -->|200| schema_LoginResponseDto
  AuthController_me -->|200| schema_UserProfileDto
  AuthController_logout -->|204| AuthController_logout_response_empty
```

| Endpoint            | Summary              | Access    | Request         | Responses                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------- | -------------------- | --------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST /auth/login`  | Sign in              | public    | body `LoginDto` | 200 `LoginResponseDto`<br>400 Invalid email or missing password.<br>401 Invalid email or password.<br>429 Too many login attempts. |
| `GET /auth/me`      | Current user profile | signed in |                 | 200 `UserProfileDto`<br>401 Missing, invalid or expired token.                                                                     |
| `POST /auth/logout` | Sign out             | public    |                 | 204 no body                                                                                                                        |

## Invoices endpoints

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  InvoicesController_list["GET /invoices<br/>List invoices<br/>signed in"]
  InvoicesController_list_query[/"query<br/>page, pageSize<br/>sortBy, ordering<br/>status, keyword<br/>fromDate, toDate"/]
  schema_InvoiceListResponseDto[/"InvoiceListResponseDto"/]
  InvoicesController_create["POST /invoices<br/>Create an invoice<br/>signed in"]
  schema_CreateInvoiceDto[/"CreateInvoiceDto"/]
  schema_InvoiceResponseDto[/"InvoiceResponseDto"/]
  InvoicesController_findOne["GET /invoices/#123;id#125;<br/>Get an invoice with its customer, line items and totals<br/>signed in"]
  InvoicesController_findOne_path[/"path<br/>id"/]
  InvoicesController_list_query --> InvoicesController_list
  InvoicesController_list -->|200| schema_InvoiceListResponseDto
  schema_CreateInvoiceDto --> InvoicesController_create
  InvoicesController_create -->|201| schema_InvoiceResponseDto
  InvoicesController_findOne_path --> InvoicesController_findOne
  InvoicesController_findOne -->|200| schema_InvoiceResponseDto
```

| Endpoint             | Summary                                                 | Access    | Request                                                                                   | Responses                                                                                                                          |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `GET /invoices`      | List invoices                                           | signed in | query `page`, `pageSize`, `sortBy`, `ordering`, `status`, `keyword`, `fromDate`, `toDate` | 200 `InvoiceListResponseDto`<br>400 Invalid query parameters.<br>401 Missing, invalid or expired token.                            |
| `POST /invoices`     | Create an invoice                                       | signed in | body `CreateInvoiceDto`                                                                   | 201 `InvoiceResponseDto`<br>400 Validation failed.<br>401 Missing, invalid or expired token.<br>409 Invoice number already exists. |
| `GET /invoices/{id}` | Get an invoice with its customer, line items and totals | signed in | path `id`                                                                                 | 200 `InvoiceResponseDto`<br>400 id is not a valid UUID.<br>401 Missing, invalid or expired token.<br>404 Invoice not found.        |

| Endpoint             | Parameter  | In    | Type    | Required | Default       | Description                                                                           | Rules                                          |
| -------------------- | ---------- | ----- | ------- | -------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `GET /invoices`      | `page`     | query | integer | no       | `1`           |                                                                                       | At least 1, at most 100000                     |
| `GET /invoices`      | `pageSize` | query | integer | no       | `10`          |                                                                                       | At least 1, at most 100                        |
| `GET /invoices`      | `sortBy`   | query | string  | no       | `invoiceDate` |                                                                                       | One of `invoiceDate`, `dueDate`, `totalAmount` |
| `GET /invoices`      | `ordering` | query | string  | no       | `DESC`        |                                                                                       | One of `ASC`, `DESC`                           |
| `GET /invoices`      | `status`   | query | string  | no       |               | Filters on the effective status, so Overdue invoices are not listed as Draft/Pending. | One of `Draft`, `Pending`, `Paid`, `Overdue`   |
| `GET /invoices`      | `keyword`  | query | string  | no       |               | Case-insensitive partial match on invoice number or customer name.                    | Up to 100 characters                           |
| `GET /invoices`      | `fromDate` | query | date    | no       |               | Invoices dated on/after (YYYY-MM-DD).                                                 |                                                |
| `GET /invoices`      | `toDate`   | query | date    | no       |               | Invoices dated on/before (YYYY-MM-DD).                                                |                                                |
| `GET /invoices/{id}` | `id`       | path  | uuid    | yes      |               | The invoiceId.                                                                        |                                                |

## Health endpoints

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  HealthController_check["GET /health<br/>Health check (API + database connectivity)<br/>public"]
  HealthController_check_response_body[/"#123; status #125;"/]
  HealthController_check -->|200| HealthController_check_response_body
```

| Endpoint      | Summary                                    | Access | Request | Responses                                     |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------ | ------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `GET /health` | Health check (API + database connectivity) | public |         | 200 `{ status }`<br>503 Database unavailable. |

## Schemas

Request and response bodies. `?` marks an optional field.

```mermaid
classDiagram
  direction LR
  class LoginDto {
    +email: string
    +password: string
  }
  class UserProfileDto {
    +id: uuid
    +email: string
    +fullname: string
    +createdAt: date-time
  }
  class LoginResponseDto {
    +accessToken: string
    +tokenType: TokenType
    +expiresIn: number
    +user: UserProfileDto
  }
  class ErrorResponseDto {
    +statusCode: number
    +message: string or string[]
    +error: string
  }
  class CustomerResponseDto {
    +fullname: string
    +email: string
    +mobileNumber: string or null
    +address: string or null
  }
  class InvoiceItemResponseDto {
    +id: uuid
    +name: string
    +quantity: integer
    +rate: number
    +amount: number
  }
  class InvoiceResponseDto {
    +invoiceId: uuid
    +invoiceNumber: string
    +invoiceReference: string or null
    +invoiceDate: date
    +dueDate: date
    +currency: Currency
    +currencySymbol: string
    +description: string or null
    +status: Status
    +customer: CustomerResponseDto
    +items: InvoiceItemResponseDto[]
    +taxPercent: number
    +invoiceSubTotal: number
    +totalTax: number
    +totalDiscount: number
    +totalAmount: number
    +totalPaid: number
    +balanceAmount: number
    +createdAt: date-time
    +createdBy: uuid
  }
  class PagingDto {
    +page: number
    +pageSize: number
    +total: number
  }
  class InvoiceListResponseDto {
    +data: InvoiceResponseDto[]
    +paging: PagingDto
  }
  class CustomerInputDto {
    +fullname: string
    +email: email
    +mobileNumber?: string
    +address?: string
  }
  class InvoiceItemInputDto {
    +name: string
    +quantity: integer
    +rate: number
  }
  class CreateInvoiceDto {
    +invoiceNumber: string
    +invoiceReference?: string
    +invoiceDate: date
    +dueDate: date
    +currency: Currency
    +description?: string
    +customer: CustomerInputDto
    +items: InvoiceItemInputDto[]
    +taxPercent?: number
    +discount?: number
  }
  class TokenType {
    <<enumeration>>
    Bearer
  }
  class Currency {
    <<enumeration>>
    AUD
    USD
    EUR
    GBP
    SGD
    NZD
    CAD
    HKD
  }
  class Status {
    <<enumeration>>
    Draft
    Pending
    Paid
    Overdue
  }
  LoginResponseDto ..> TokenType
  LoginResponseDto --> UserProfileDto : user
  InvoiceResponseDto ..> Currency
  InvoiceResponseDto ..> Status
  InvoiceResponseDto --> CustomerResponseDto : customer
  InvoiceResponseDto --> "*" InvoiceItemResponseDto : items
  InvoiceListResponseDto --> "*" InvoiceResponseDto : data
  InvoiceListResponseDto --> PagingDto : paging
  CreateInvoiceDto ..> Currency
  CreateInvoiceDto --> CustomerInputDto : customer
  CreateInvoiceDto --> "1" InvoiceItemInputDto : items
```
